get.description:
<small>

<!-- theme: info -->
> ## Описание
>
> Возвращает страницу книг вместе с метаданными пагинации. Каждая книга
> отдаётся вместе со списком авторов и категорией.

<!-- theme: info -->
> ## Фильтры
>
> | Параметр | Действие |
> |---|---|
> | `title` | Совпадение по части названия |
> | `authorSlug` | Книги указанного автора |
> | `categorySlug` | Книги указанной категории |
>
> Фильтр по автору не урезает список авторов внутри книги: книга по-прежнему
> отдаётся со всеми соавторами.

<!-- theme: info -->
> ## Пример
>
> ```http
> GET /api/v1/book/admin/books?authorSlug=george-orwell&page=1&per_page=15
> ```

</small>

200.description: Страница книг вместе с метаданными пагинации.

post.description:
<small>

<!-- theme: info -->
> ## Описание
>
> Создаёт книгу и её связи. Запрос отправляется как `multipart/form-data`,
> потому что вместе с полями может прийти файл обложки.

<!-- theme: info -->
> ## Бизнес-правила
>
> - Категория с указанным `categoryId` должна существовать.
> - Все авторы из `authorIds` должны существовать; нужен хотя бы один.
> - ISBN не должен быть занят другой книгой.
> - Slug не должен быть занят другой книгой.
> - Slug нормализуется перед сохранением.

<!-- theme: warning -->
> ## Ошибки
>
> | Код | Статус | Причина |
> |---|---|---|
> | `CATEGORY_NOT_EXIST` | 400 | Категория не найдена |
> | `AUTHOR_NOT_EXIST` | 400 | Один или несколько авторов не найдены |
> | `BOOK_ISBN_ALREADY_EXISTS` | 400 | ISBN занят |
> | `BOOK_SLUG_ALREADY_EXISTS` | 400 | Slug занят |
> | `BOOK_MUST_HAVE_AUTHOR` | 400 | Список авторов пуст |
> | `BOOK_INVALID_DATA` | 400 | Нарушен инвариант поля |

</small>

get.description:
<small>

<!-- theme: info -->
> ## Описание
>
> Возвращает одну книгу по её slug вместе с авторами и категорией.

<!-- theme: danger -->
> Если книги с таким slug нет, возвращается **404** с кодом `BOOK_NOT_FOUND`.

</small>

patch.description:
<small>

<!-- theme: info -->
> ## Поведение
>
> Частичное обновление: изменяются только присланные поля.
>
> | Данные запроса | Результат |
> |---|---|
> | Поле передано | Значение обновляется |
> | Поле опущено | Прежнее значение сохраняется |
> | Некорректное значение | Ошибка валидации (422) |
>
> Присланный `authorIds` заменяет список авторов целиком, а не дополняет его.
> Новая обложка заменяет старую, старый файл удаляется после успешного
> сохранения.

<!-- theme: info -->
> ## Бизнес-правила
>
> - Книга с указанным slug должна существовать.
> - Новый ISBN и новый slug не должны быть заняты другой книгой.
> - Присланная категория и все присланные авторы должны существовать.

</small>

delete.description:
<small>

<!-- theme: info -->
> ## Описание
>
> Удаляет книгу по slug. Связи с авторами удаляются вместе с ней, файл обложки
> удаляется из хранилища. Восстановить книгу нельзя.

<!-- theme: info -->
> ## Успешный ответ
>
> - **HTTP-статус:** `204 No Content`
> - Тело ответа пустое.

</small>

get.description:
<small>

<!-- theme: info -->
> ## Automatic Redirect Creation for Slug Changes
>
> When updating brand slug, redirects are created automatically based on brand status:
>
> | Brand Status | Redirect Behavior |
> |-------------|------------------|
> | PUBLISHED | Creates redirect: `old-slug → new-slug` (all locales) |
> | DRAFT/ARCHIVED | No redirect created |

<!-- theme: warning -->
> Note: To change brand status, use the dedicated `/status` endpoint instead.

<!-- theme: info -->
> ## Translation Support
>
> This endpoint supports translations. Use the `locale` parameter to update specific locale, or pass translatable fields as objects with locale keys for multiple translations.

</small>

post.description:
<small>

<!-- theme: info -->
> ##  Description
>
> Creates a new book category.
> The category title and slug must be unique.
> If the request is valid, a new category is stored and returned.

<!-- theme: info -->
> ##  Business Rules
>
> - A category with the same title cannot already exist.
> - A category with the same slug cannot already exist.
> - The slug is normalized before being saved.
> - Both title and slug are required.

</small>

201.description:
<small>

<!-- theme: info -->
> ## Success Response
>
> The request was processed successfully.
>
> - **HTTP Status:** `200 OK`
> - Returns the created category object.
> - Includes the generated **UUID**.
> - Includes the creation and last update timestamps.
>
> ## Example
>
> **Request**
>
> ```http
> POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/book/admin/categories
> ```
>
> ```json
> {
>   "title": "HELLO WOfefeRLD",
>   "slug": "132131232111H1ELLO WOfewfwefewfRLdddD"
> }
> ```
>
> **Response — 200 OK**
>
> ```json
> {
>   "id": "81710a04-1a71-0f7f-f346-492fce342498",
>   "title": "HELLO WOfefeRLD",
>   "slug": "132131232111h1ello-wofewfwefewfrldddd",
>   "createdAt": "2026-07-28T09:53:53.268Z",
>   "updatedAt": "2026-07-28T09:53:53.268Z"
> }
> ```

</small>

400.description:
<small>

<!-- theme: danger -->
> ## Error Response
>
> The request could not be processed because the submitted data violates one or more business rules.
>
> - **HTTP Status:** `400 Bad Request`
> - Returns the application error code.
> - Returns a human-readable error message.
>
> ## Example
>
> **Request**
>
> ```http
> POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/book/admin/categories
> ```
>
> ```json
> {
>   "title": "HELLO WOfefwefeRLfewD",
>   "slug": "132131232111H1ELLO WOfewfweffewwfRLdddD"
> }
> ```
>
> **Response — 400 Bad Request**
>
> ```json
> {
>   "statusCode": 400,
>   "errorCode": "BOOK_ALREADY_EXIST",
>   "message": "Book already exist"
> }
> ```

</small>

patch.description:
<small>

<!-- theme: info -->
> ## Update Behavior
>
> This endpoint performs a partial update.
> Only the fields included in the request body are modified.
> Existing values remain unchanged if a field is omitted.
>
> | Request Data | Result |
> |-------------|--------|
> | Field provided | Value is updated |
> | Field omitted | Existing value is preserved |
> | Invalid value | Validation error (400) |

<!-- theme:  info -->
> ## Business Rules
>
> - The category must exist.
> - Only the fields included in the request are updated.
> - Fields omitted from the request remain unchanged.
> - The updated slug must be unique across all categories.


<!-- theme: warning -->
> ## Permissions
>
> - Authentication is required.
> - Only users with permission to manage categories can update a category.
> - Unauthorized users receive **401 Unauthorized**.
> - Users without sufficient permissions receive **403 Forbidden**.


<!-- theme: warning -->
> ## Validation Rules
>
> - The category **slug** parameter is required.
> - The request body must contain valid data.
> - The **slug** must be unique if it is updated.
> - String fields cannot be empty.
> - Validation errors return **400 Bad Request**.

<!-- theme: info -->
> ## Examples
>
> **Request**
>
> ```json
> PATCH http://localhost:8000/api/v1/book/admin/categories/{slug}
>
> {
>   "slug": "science-fiction-fantasy"
> }
> ```

</small>

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Unique slug of the category to update.

200.description: The category was updated successfully and the latest version has been returned.

400.description:
> ## Example
>
> The following example demonstrates a request that references a category that does not exist.
> In this case, the API returns a **400 Bad Request** response with the corresponding error code.
>
> **Request**
>
> ```http
> PATCH /api/v1/book/admin/categories/{slug}
> Content-Type: application/json
>
> {
>   "slug": "new-category"
> }
> ```
>
> **Response**
>
> ```json
> {
>   "statusCode": 400,
>   "errorCode": "CATEGORY_NOT_EXIST",
>   "message": "Category not exist"
> }
> ```

404.description:
> ## Example
>
> The requested endpoint does not exist or the URL is incorrect.
> Verify that the request path and HTTP method are correct before sending the request.
>
> **Request**
>
> ```http
> PATCH /api/v1/book/admin/categories/
> ```
>
> **Response**
>
> ```json
> {
>   "statusCode": 404,
>   "error": "Not Found",
>   "message": "Cannot PATCH /api/v1/book/admin/categories/"
> }
> ```

delete.description:
<small>

<!-- theme: info -->
> ##  Description
>
> Deletes an existing category by its unique slug.
> Once deleted, the category can no longer be retrieved or updated.

<!-- theme: info -->
> ##  Business Rules
>
> - The category must exist.
> - The category is permanently removed from the system.
> - A deleted category cannot be restored.

<!-- theme: info -->
> ##  Permissions
>
> - Only authenticated administrators are allowed to delete categories.

<!-- theme: info -->
> ##  Success Response
>
> If the category is successfully deleted, the API returns:
>
> - **HTTP Status:** `204 No Content`
> - The response body is empty.

</small>

get.description:
Returns one page of authors together with pagination metadata.

The query parameters control which page is returned. For example:

```http
GET /admin/authors?page=1&per_page=25
```

An equivalent JavaScript request:

```js
const response = await fetch("/admin/authors?page=1&per_page=25");
const authors = await response.json();
```

The response contains the authors in `data` and pagination information in `meta`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to return. Numbering starts at 1.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Maximum number of authors per page. The minimum accepted value is 5.

200.description: The paginated author collection was returned successfully.

post.description:
Validates the request body and persists a new author.

All fields except `avatar` are required. The date string is converted to a JavaScript
`Date` before validation.

The controller passes the validated DTO to `CreateAuthorAction`. The current endpoint responds
with HTTP 201 after persistence and does not return the created author in the response body.

201.description: The author was created successfully. The response body is empty.

400.description:
The request failed DTO validation or violated a business rule.

Examples include an empty name, an invalid avatar URL, or a date that cannot be converted to a
valid `Date`.

info.title: Blog API
info.description:
REST API for a blog: authentication, role-based access, categories, and posts.

**Base path:** all endpoints are served under `/api`.

**Authentication:** obtain a JWT via `POST /api/auth/register` or `POST /api/auth/login`,
then send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Endpoints marked with a lock require it;
some public endpoints (e.g. listing posts) use the token, when present, to widen visibility.

**Roles:** `USER` (default) and `ADMIN`. Category writes are admin-only;
post writes are restricted to the author or an admin.

**Errors:** every non-2xx response uses a single envelope —
`{ "error": { "code": string, "message": string, "details": object[] | null } }`.
Branch on the stable `code`, not the human-readable `message`.

**Rate limiting:** auth endpoints allow 100 requests per 15-minute window per client.
